hub.tagline: Drag through every open cell to fill the board. Stuck? Rewind along your own trail and try another route.

all.title: Drag to fill every open cell
all.desc: Press and drag through the open cells, one step at a time, to color them in. The board is won as soon as every open cell is colored.

all.title: Obstacles block the way
all.desc: Dark cells are obstacles -- you can't step on them. Your path has to weave around them to reach every open cell.

all.title: Stuck? Touch back along your own trail
all.desc: Touching an earlier point on the trail you've already drawn rewinds the path back to there, uncoloring everything after it. No move is ever permanent -- there's no way to lose, just rewind and try a different route.

all.title: Can't cross your own trail
all.desc: The path can never revisit a cell it has already colored -- plan your route so it does not trap itself before every open cell is filled.

game.stuckMessage: No route from here -- rewind and try again
game.legend: drag through open cells to fill them -- touch back along your trail to rewind
game.hintFailToast: No path from here reaches every cell -- try rewinding.
game.winSubtitle: Every cell filled -- next board unlocked.
